cohort: Patients undergoing surgical procedures at the Obstetrics and Gynecology unit of Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar from January 2017 to December 2018.
finding: The frequency of iatrogenic injury to the urological tract in obstetrics was 0.036%, with the urinary bladder being the most frequently damaged viscera, while in gynecological procedures, the injury rate was 0.45%.
